name: com.chinacaremap.mcp/china-medical-guide
title: ChinaCareMap: Medical Treatment in China
description: Hospitals, prices, visas and booking help for foreigners getting medical treatment in China.

tools.name: search_hospitals
tools.description: Find hospitals in China that foreign patients use, filtered by city, specialty and whether they have an international department or English-speaking service. Returns each hospital's name (English and Chinese), city, type, what it is known for, and a link to its ChinaCareMap guide. Use get_hospital for address, map links, booking notes and sources. Call with no arguments to list all hospitals.

city.description: City: beijing (Beijing), shanghai (Shanghai), hangzhou (Hangzhou), guangzhou (Guangzhou), shenzhen (Shenzhen), wuhan (Wuhan), chengdu (Chengdu), hainan (Hainan (Boao))

specialty.description: Specialty: cancer (Cancer), heart (Heart), neuro (Brain & nerves), checkup (Health check-ups), dental (Dental), eye (Eye care), general (General & complex cases), family (Family, maternity & kids), tcm (Chinese medicine (TCM)), newdrugs (Drugs approved abroad)

international_service_only.description: Only hospitals with an international department or expat-focused, English-speaking service.

query.description: Free-text match on hospital name (English or Chinese) or what it is known for, e.g. 'liver', 'Huashan', '协和'.

tools.name: get_hospital
tools.description: Full details for one hospital: Chinese name, address in English and Chinese, coordinates and map links, international department, how foreign patients get in, official website, source links and the ChinaCareMap guide page.

id.description: Hospital id from search_hospitals (e.g. 'pumch'), or a hospital name in English or Chinese.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Official and published prices for foreign patients in China, each with its source page: doctor_visit (consultation fees by doctor rank at public hospitals, special-needs clinics), dental_implants (national price limits, implant and crown prices), health_checkup (package prices at six hospitals).

tools.name: get_travel_guide
tools.description: Curated answers for one fixed topic of a medical trip to China. Use this when the user's question clearly fits one of these topics: how_it_works (step-by-step plan), visa (medical visa, 240-hour transit, Hainan 30-day visa-free entry for treatment), booking (how foreigners book appointments), language (English service and interpreters), payment (Alipay/WeChat Pay with foreign cards, deposits), insurance, safety (quality, accreditation, transplants), cities. Always prefer this tool for plain visa, booking, language, payment, insurance, safety or city questions. Only for a narrow question outside these topics (e.g. 'can I bring my own medicine') use search_faq instead. For prices use get_prices; for hospitals use search_hospitals.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Free-text search across all of ChinaCareMap's sourced FAQ answers about medical treatment in China. Use this for a specific question in the user's own words, or when it is unclear which get_travel_guide topic applies. Returns up to 5 best-matching questions with answers and page links. Rule: a plain question about visas, booking, language, payment, insurance, safety or cities (e.g. 'do I need a visa?', 'how do I pay?') goes to get_travel_guide with that topic, not here. For a full article, use get_guide.

query.description: The question or keywords, e.g. 'do foreigners pay more', 'dental implant trips'.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List every in-depth guide on chinacaremap.com with its id, title, one-line summary and link: overview of medical tourism in China, hospital list, doctor visit costs, dental implants, dental tourism, health check-ups, Shenzhen, how hospitals are chosen, and about the service. Pass an id to get_guide to read the full text.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Full text of one ChinaCareMap guide, as published on the website (headings, tables and prices included), with its link and last-checked date. Use when the user wants the complete article or details beyond the FAQ answers. Ids: medical-tourism-china, hospitals, doctor-visit-cost-in-china, dental-implants-in-china, dental-tourism-china, health-checkup-in-china, how-we-choose-hospitals, shenzhen-medical-tourism, about.

tools.name: get_patient_assistance
tools.description: How to get ChinaCareMap's patient assistance service: hospital matching and appointments, visa invitation and travel, an English-speaking coordinator at appointments, payment and follow-up. Returns what the service covers, the fee policy and how to contact the team. Use when the user wants someone to arrange treatment for them.
